content:
The **Baseball Grenade** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*.

## Gameplay[edit]

A grenade created by hollowing out a baseball and filling it with explosives and fragmentation. A pin at the top of the grenade is pulled to start a fuse which sets off the explosives inside. The baseball grenade is more powerful and heavier than a standard Frag Grenade.

## Crafting[edit]

| | | **Build at:** **Learn Method:** | | Baseball Grenade (1) | 

## Locations[edit]

- Sometimes found on humanoid enemies.
- Can be rewarded from Daily Ops.
- Sometimes found in explosive crates.
